title: Don't abuse exploits.
details: Cooldowns apply to you as a person. Using any means to increase the amount you can feed a worm is not fair to other users. If you find something that might be an unintended exploit, please report it in worm chat or email admin@codecreature.net!

details: User accounts and chat participation are subject to their own rules, found here.
